mapper.select: select distinct site_route as "route",principal as "principal",stack_id as "stackId",area_id as "areaId" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2'
SELECT site_name FROM tb_stack where id = #{stackId}
select site_name from tb_ware_area where id = #{areaId}

select warning_type as "warningType",node_id as "nodeId", CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN warning_val_three WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_val_two WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_val_one END as "warningVal", CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' END AS "warningGrade" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and site_route = #{siteRoute}
